title: Annotatio VI §.VIII open: Ex omnibus — Supper dissent not faith-fundamental (to Werensdorf)
pass_a_gloss: §. VIII. From all things hitherto disputed, and partly asserted and defended, partly denied and destroyed, I should believe it can abundantly be clear to any Reader, even to the Wittenberg Disputant, the most learned Domine Werensdorf, that those things in which Protestants dissent about Christ’s Sacred Supper are not of such weight that they can make the Dissensus Fundamental.
pass_b_english: §.VIII: from all disputed so far — asserted or denied — it should be clear even to Wittenberg’s Werensdorf.
Protestant disagreements about the Sacred Supper are not of such weight as to make the dissensus faith-fundamental.
source_text: §. VIII. Ex omnibus hactenus disputatis, & partim assertis defensísque, partim negatis ac destructis, crediderim, Lectori cuivis, etiam Wittebergensi Disputatori, Doctissimo Domino Werensdorfio abundè constare posse, tanti non esse, in quibus circa Cœnam Christi Sacram Protestantes dissentiunt, ut Dissensum ea efficere possint Fundamentalem.
